title: Vehicles and Trips the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan Levels Will Not Cover
content:
A level of the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan is written for vehicles up to a stated value and for trips of
a stated kind and length. The longest trip covered is the longest reserved period the level will carry; the
value ceiling is the marketplace valuation above which the level will not cover the trip at all; the excluded
value classes are the Keyturn Vehicle Listing value classes the level will not cover whatever the valuation;
and the last three columns state whether carriage for commercial purposes, a trip leaving the vehicle's home
state and a trip crossing an international border are covered.

| Protection level | Longest trip covered (whole days) | Vehicle value above which the level will not cover (USD) | Listing value classes not covered | Commercial carriage covered | Trip leaving the home state covered | Trip crossing an international border covered |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Declined Protection | 90 | 60000.00 | Keyturn Exotic Class Listing, Keyturn Luxury Class Listing | no | yes | no |
| Keyturn Minimum Protection | 60 | 85000.00 | Keyturn Exotic Class Listing | no | yes | no |
| Keyturn Standard Protection | 60 | 120000.00 | Keyturn Exotic Class Listing | no | yes | no |
| Keyturn Advantage Protection | 90 | 175000.00 | none | no | yes | yes |
| Keyturn Premier Protection | 120 | 300000.00 | none | no | yes | yes |
| Keyturn Business Traveler Protection | 180 | 300000.00 | none | yes | yes | yes |

## Restated as the limits of one election

For any one election the level fixes four limits at once: a length limit in whole days, a value limit in USD, a
list of value classes shut out whatever the valuation, and three switches for the kind of journey. The length
limit does not rise monotonically with price — Keyturn Minimum Protection and Keyturn Standard Protection both
carry 60 days while Keyturn Declined Protection and Keyturn Advantage Protection carry 90 — whereas the value
limit rises at every rung from 60000.00 USD to 300000.00 USD, the top two levels sharing that figure.

## Two hypothetical vehicles read against the schedule

A hypothetical car the marketplace values at 100000.00 USD and classes as a Keyturn Premium Class Listing falls
under the value ceiling of Keyturn Standard Protection, which is 120000.00 USD, and its class appears in no
level's excluded list, so no value limit shuts that level out. A hypothetical car valued at 100000.00 USD but
classed as a Keyturn Exotic Class Listing is excluded by class from Keyturn Declined Protection, Keyturn
Minimum Protection and Keyturn Standard Protection, on each of which that class is listed, and is not excluded
by class from the three levels above them, which list none.

Carriage for commercial purposes is covered on Keyturn Business Traveler Protection alone. A trip leaving the
vehicle's home state is covered on every level. A trip crossing an international border is covered on Keyturn
Advantage Protection, Keyturn Premier Protection and Keyturn Business Traveler Protection only.
